南洋廳統計年鑑 1935

Nan'yōchō tōkei nenkan (Statistical Yearbook of the South Seas Government), 第五回 (No. 5), figures mainly for 昭和6–10 (1931–1935), published 昭和12年3月 (March 1937)
南洋廳長官官房文書課, パラオ (昭和十二年)

All 220 numbered tables are transcribed, with the appendix table of weights and measures (度量衡比較表); the contents, the maps, the statistical charts (統計圖表), the prose survey (概說) and the colophon are not. Tables printed across both pages of a spread are joined into one, and long tables read in sections by different readers are joined. Printed totals were re-added by the readers: totals that do not add up are kept as printed and noted; where they looked like a misread digit, the cell was re-read by a reader who had not seen the first reading. Where a digit was ambiguous only between 3 and 8 and exactly one reading made a printed total reconcile, that reading is used and noted. Figures are kept exactly as printed, including points or spaces printed where a comma or decimal point is expected. Small figures printed above a cell (foreigners, half-year taxpayers, quantities) are given in the same cell after the figure. The volume's errata slip (正誤表, 48 corrections) is attached as a note to each table it concerns; the figures stay as printed. About 20 of some 81,000 figure cells could not be read and are marked [?]; a literal ? printed in the book is kept as ?.
